get.description:
Agenda read: the acting organization's appointments, half-open window.

The window is ``[from_date, to_date)``; both bounds are optional and
passed as RFC 3339 instants. Location/practitioner filters narrow the
result; the tenant always comes from the context, never from a query
parameter (X3).

AdjustmentCreate.title: AdjustmentCreate
AdjustmentCreate.description: A reason-required correction at one location (a movement row, always).

AppointmentCancel.title: AppointmentCancel
AppointmentCancel.description:
Empty by design: the appointment is identified by the path, and nothing
about the cancellation is caller-supplied. ``extra='forbid'`` keeps a
client from smuggling state through the body.

AppointmentListItem.title: AppointmentListItem
AppointmentListItem.description:
Agenda read DTO: the appointment plus the names the agenda renders.

The names are joined at the application boundary (relationships), so the
frontend never needs per-row lookups and never sees raw mockData shapes.

EntryCreate.title: EntryCreate
EntryCreate.description: A purchase/initial stock input, targeted at one location.

TransferCreate.title: TransferCreate
TransferCreate.description: Move stock between two locations of the same organization.

IntegrationBearer.description: Revocable server-to-server credential. Never embed it in a browser.
